findings.verdict: Qualified fixture input reads passed; not a complete native withdrawal or all optional numerical branch matrix.

findings.fact: Daily-row projection accepted read-only condition, manager and carried backing; no actual effects or days credited.
findings.verdict: Input preservation passed; returned mutable diagnostic/accounting DTO is outside the proposed row cache.

findings.fact: Battle conversion passes reduced history to a new choose call; council continuation changes capability scope. Same snapshot does not identify the same planning input.
findings.verdict: Cache must be owned by one choose invocation; do not inherit it into child recursion.

findings.fact: Preview clears/replaces the retreat token; order clears it before fresh reads/submission; settlement finalizer calls native terminal and records success or failure.
findings.verdict: These state-changing controls are outside pure planning and cannot be cached or skipped.

minimum_patch_boundary.not_yet_qualified: The complete core plus all post-review and event-registry consumers have not been transitively proved to preserve outer row/list/index containers.

Keep new cache scope for battle-reduced-history and council capability recursion.
